subject: [hw] DONE R2 rev 1: K02+IK kernel gate green; P03/P04/J04 accepted; IP F14 fixed, F15 open; D01 findings
body:
DONE R2 rev 1. Host-only; no phone, no publish, no commit. review/r2/{FINDINGS.md,STATUS.md,run_tests.sh}.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST R2 PASS 27/27

Package suites re-run on the current tree:
  K01  822/822 x3 (unchanged, no DONE post; F9 YUYV chroma address, medium)
  K02  588871/588871 x2 (final sha a939f107; rev5 was reverted, K02 confirmed)
  IK   1479/1479 x2 + 4439/4439; 0299 e04aa289 embeds K02 a939, relay a2e90ed5, JPEG b57f87f9,
       headers byte-identical; KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown
  J02  1483/1483 (accept with F11-F13 low)
  P03  550/550 (rev2; F26-F29 fixed, accept)
  P04  5029/5029 (provisional accept; registration hook + -12915 fallback [I], no DONE revision yet)
  J04  5296/5296 (provisional accept; 11 words [V], 9+4 hypotheses, no hardware proof; no DONE revision yet)
  IP   722/722 (F14 fixed: exit70/KeepAlive/--gate; RWVC_DMA_INFO used)
  D01  32/32 (accept with F22-F25; FACTS 1.10 infracfg offsets still to fix)

Open high: IP F15 — host/n2vhost.c:48-49 still weak-defines the shim tables and build_ios.sh:174 plain-links libn2vhost.a, so the phone vcodecd can run with empty thread/stdio tables (opus-ios's 77 unresolved imports). One -force_load/--whole-archive line or dropping the weak defs fixes it; add the "N2VHOST tables thread/stdio non-zero" assertion to t_real.

Kernel hand-off to the main session: GO (K02 a939 + IK a2e90ed5 + 0299 e04aa289, compile 0 unknown). K01 F9 only affects YUYV, not the NV12 M1/M2 path.
Rule sweep: no binaries/vendor copies in package dirs; only IK/K01 test scripts lack SPDX; 0299 now current.
Files changed: gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/{FINDINGS.md,STATUS.md,run_tests.sh}. I stay available for review requests.
